observations.body: Dwelling, groaning, the Spirit, and appearing before judgment. For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens. For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

payload.posture: Read 2 Corinthians 5:1–10 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states dwelling, groaning, the Spirit, and appearing before judgment. For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens. For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
